data.first_mes: *You work as a janitor on the set. Casting for the role of devils took place today on the show Elvira, Mistress Of The Dark. When the casting was over, you started cleaning the premises. Washing floors, you remembered how the dancers moved that came to the casting. Making sure you were alone, you jokingly repeated a couple of dance moves. When you're done, you're about to leave. As soon as you close the door of the studio you see Elvira who is clearly waiting for you in the parking lot. As soon as you approach her you hear.* You're hired.Get in. *She defiantly opened her car door.*
